title: Review scores kept in files beside a title, shown, sorted and filtered by
description: A viewer would see a title's review scores from the files kept beside it, and could sort or narrow Films and Shows by them. PRODUCT.md promises no scores.
bringBack: When stage 5's metadata from files is split into tasks: evidence of how many collections' files carry scores, and whether showing them fits 'What is suggested comes from the titles themselves and from the viewer'.
